shortDescription.default: Build Outlook-ready HTML newsletters, store them in SharePoint and schedule sending via Power Automate.

longDescription.default: Newsletter Builder: layout editor with people announcement sections (new joiners, celebrations, promotions, exam passes). Saves newsletters to a document library and schedules sends in a SharePoint list processed by Power Automate. Creates the library and list on first run.

features.title: Newsletter Builder
features.description: Adds the Newsletter Builder web part.
